item.title: Central Command Confirms USAF Jets Downed By Friendly Fire
item.description: U.S. Central Command confirms three Air Force jets have been shot down in a friendly fire incident in Kuwait. The F-15 E Strike Eagles flying in support of Operation Epic Fury were shot down by Kuwaiti air defenses during active combat that included Iranian aircraft, ballistic missiles and drones. All six crew members ejected safely and are listed in stable condition. The incident is under investigation.

item.title: Federal And City Officials Say The Man Who Opened Fire Outside A Texas Bar Was Not On Their Radar
item.description: By JIM VERTUNO and LEKAN OYEKANAMI Associated Press AUSTIN, Texas (AP) — Federal and city authorities say the gunman who opened fire outside a Texas bar, killing two people and wounding 14 more was not on their radar before the attack. item.title: Robotaxi Blocks EMS
item.description: The self-driving taxi company Waymo is under fire after video shows one of their cars blocking an ambulance that was responding to the shooting in Austin. It took a police officer about one minute to convince the car to exit the scene. A spokeswoman for Austin-Travis County EMS says they prepare for this scenario and said there was not a “significant impact to patient care or overall response operations.”
